query: WITH entities AS ((SELECT email, id FROM subscribers WHERE ((email IS NULL OR (email, id) < ($3, $2))) AND ($2 IS NOT NULL AND $3 IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY email DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT $1) UNION ALL (SELECT email, id FROM subscribers WHERE ((email IS NULL AND id < $2)) AND ($2 IS NOT NULL AND $3 IS NULL) ORDER BY email DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT $1) UNION ALL (SELECT email, id FROM subscribers WHERE ($2 IS NULL) ORDER BY email DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT $1) ORDER BY email DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT $1) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id!: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $4 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, p.payload as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN subscriber_events e ON i.id = e.id LEFT JOIN subscribers_forgettable_payloads p ON e.id = p.entity_id AND e.sequence = p.sequence ORDER BY i.email desc nulls last, i.id desc, i.id, e.sequence
